reason: My agency already gets me the few paid deals I have, and every influencer app I've tried just showed me barter stuff or nothing at all. Free is nice, but I'm not spending time on a media kit and profile until I see it actually brings money.
objection: Are there really cafés and gyms in Bengaluru paying small creators like me through this, or will I turn on 'find me' and get zero invites like every other app?
would_change_my_mind: A creator my size in Bengaluru showing me a real paid invite with the fee written down that they got through Mitra, or a friend sending me one.
